description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order Under Sec. 25 A of the Universities Act, (National School of Business & Management Ltd
reasoning: This gazette contains an order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework for higher education. It amends a previous gazette notification to add a new degree program (Bachelor of Science Honours in Data Science) and specifies regulatory conditions for its implementation, including minimum entry qualifications and review requirements. This constitutes subsidiary legislation under the principal Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
